Description

The Arianna Short-Sleeve Top is a fine-knit layer made to be worn close to the skin. Short sleeves add a little extra warmth while staying discreet under knitwear and jackets.

Wool keeps you warm and manages moisture, while silk adds a smooth, soft feel next to the skin.

Material & care

Composition: 85% Wool 15% Silk

Hand wash in cool water with a mild wool or silk detergent. Don't wring; dry flat away from direct heat. Always check the care label.

Size & fit

Close, second-skin fit in S, M and L. Between sizes or prefer a looser layer? Size up. Exchanges to another size are free of hassle within 14 days.

Delivery & returns

Ships Monday–Friday. 2–5 days within Norway & Europe (Posten / UPS), 4–10 days worldwide. Returns and size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Full policy
